privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.p: ZYXEN is a software engineering studio based in Athens, Greece, and the controller of the personal data described here. We provide website, commerce, application and automation services. Contact: hello@zyxen.gr

Through our contact form we collect what you choose to send: your name, email address, the service you are interested in, an optional budget range, an optional link to your current website and your message. When you submit the form, your IP address is used for a few minutes, in memory only, to limit repeated submissions and protect the form from abuse; it is not stored with your enquiry. We do not collect sensitive personal data, financial information, or data from minors.

We use submitted information solely to: (a) respond to your project inquiry, (b) send you a confirmation email, (c) record the enquiry in our internal customer records so we can follow up, and (d) follow up regarding your project scope. We do not use your data for marketing without explicit consent. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before a possible contract and our legitimate interest in answering business enquiries.

Enquiries are delivered to our email inboxes and recorded in our internal customer records. We retain inquiry data for up to 24 months after the last meaningful contact, after which it is permanently deleted. You may request deletion at any time.

We do not sell, trade, or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes. We use these service providers, which process data on our behalf under their data processing terms: Vercel (website hosting and privacy-friendly visitor statistics), Resend (delivery of the enquiry and confirmation emails) and Notion (our internal customer records). Some of them may process data outside the European Economic Area; where they do, the transfer relies on the safeguards in their data processing terms.
We use Vercel Web Analytics to count page views and understand which pages are useful. It does not use cookies, does not build profiles of visitors and does not track you across other websites.

Under GDPR, you have the right to: access your data, correct inaccurate data, request deletion, restrict processing, object to processing and receive your data in a portable format. To exercise these rights, contact: hello@zyxen.gr. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (www.dpa.gr).
This website does not use cookies for statistics, advertising or tracking. See our Cookie Policy for details.
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.
We may update this policy periodically. Material changes will be communicated via our website. Continued use constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
For any privacy-related queries: hello@zyxen.gr | ZYXEN, Athens, Greece

cookies.title: Cookie Policy

sections.p: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help sites remember your preferences and understand how you use them.

This website does not set cookies for statistics, advertising, marketing or tracking, and it does not load social media tracking pixels. Because no such cookies are used, there is no cookie consent banner.
We use Vercel Web Analytics to count page views. It works without cookies and does not identify individual visitors or follow them across other websites.
Links to other websites, such as the client projects in our portfolio, take you to sites with their own cookie policies, which we do not control.
You can view and delete cookies, or block them entirely, in your browser settings.
Questions about our cookie use: hello@zyxen.gr
